title: Firmware Developer
description: Job Requirements Job Description: Senior Firmware Engineer – Smart Home & IoT Role Purpose We are looking for an experienced Senior Firmware Engineer – Home & IoT with 8–10 years of hands-on embedded firmware development experience to design and develop connected products for residential energy management and home automation. The role will work across products such as smart switches, dimmers, smart plugs, fan controllers, energy monitoring devices and IoT gateways , with a strong focus on reliable embedded firmware, Wi-Fi connectivity, device communication protocols, secure cloud connectivity, and integration with Azure IoT / IoT Hub . The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable working close to the hardware, debugging firmware and communication issues, and working with cloud/mobile/software teams to deliver robust end-to-end IoT products. Key Responsibilities Firmware Development Design, develop, integrate and maintain production-grade embedded firmware using C/C++ . Develop firmware for MCUs/SoCs , preferably platforms such as STM32, ESP32, Nordic nRF, NXP, Silicon Labs, Renesas or similar . Work with RTOS-based embedded systems , preferably FreeRTOS, ThreadX/Azure RTOS, Zephyr or equivalent. Develop and optimize device drivers, HAL/BSP components, bootloaders, peripheral interfaces and application firmware . Perform board bring-up, hardware/firmware integration and low-level debugging using JTAG/SWD, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and protocol analyzers . Home & Energy Products Hands-on firmware experience with one or more connected product categories: o Smart switches and relays o Dimmers and lighting controls o Smart plugs o Fan controllers o Energy monitoring/metering devices o Home automation controllers o IoT gateways / edge devices Connectivity & Protocols Strong hands-on experience with Wi-Fi , including provisioning/onboarding, network reconnection, credential management and connectivity troubleshooting. Experience with embedded communication protocols such as: o MQTT o HTTP/HTTPS o TCP/IP o TLS o UART o SPI o I²C o CAN / RS-485 where applicable Knowledge of BACnet/IP or BACnet MS/TP is desirable, particularly for gateway or building/home integration. Exposure to BLE, Zigbee, Thread and Matter would be a strong advantage. Azure IoT & Cloud Integration Hands-on experience connecting embedded/IoT devices with Azure IoT Hub or equivalent cloud IoT platforms. Experience implementing: o Device provisioning and authentication o MQTT-based telemetry o Device-to-cloud and cloud-to-device messaging o Device twins / desired and reported properties o Commands and remote device management o Firmware/device configuration management o Connectivity recovery and offline handling Familiarity with Azure Device Provisioning Service (DPS) is desirable. OTA & Device Lifecycle Design and implement reliable OTA firmware upgrade mechanisms. Implement firmware validation, rollback/recovery strategies and fail-safe upgrade mechanisms. Develop and maintain bootloaders, flash partitioning, firmware image formats and version management. Cybersecurity Implement embedded security practices including: o Secure boot o Signed firmware o TLS-based communication o Certificate/key management o Device identity o Secure firmware updates o Protection of credentials and sensitive information Understanding of IoT threat models and secure product-development practices. Quality & Product Reliability Perform unit testing, integration testing, system testing and firmware/hardware debugging. Investigate field issues using device logs, traces and telemetry and drive root-cause analysis. Design firmware for 24x7 connected-device operation , including watchdogs, brown-out recovery, connectivity recovery, memory/resource management and fault handling. Work closely with hardware, mobile-app, cloud, system architecture, cybersecurity, validation and product teams. Engineering Ownership Own firmware architecture and design decisions for connected products. Conduct design and code reviews; set coding standards and best practices. Contribute to MCU/module selection and hardware design reviews. Maintain technical documentation and support effort estimation and planning. Required Technical Skills Area Expected Experience Embedded development 8–10 years Programming Strong Embedded C / C++ OS FreeRTOS, Zephyr, Eclipse ThreadX (Azure RTOS) or equivalent MCU/SoC STM32, ESP32, Nordic, NXP, Silicon Labs, Renesas or similar Connectivity Wi-Fi, TCP/IP (required); BLE (desirable) IoT protocols MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS Smart-home standards Matter, Thread, Zigbee, Z-Wave, BACnet (desirable) Interfaces UART, I²C, SPI, GPIO, ADC, PWM; CAN/RS-485 desirable Cloud Azure IoT Hub (preferred) or equivalent such as AWS IoT Core Device management OTA/FOTA, bootloader, provisioning, diagnostics Security Secure boot, TLS, certificates, signed firmware Tools Git, JTAG/SWD, debugger, oscilloscope, logic analyzer Development practices CI/CD, code reviews, static analysis, unit/integration testing Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems or a related engineering discipline. 8–10 years of relevant hands-on embedded firmware/product-development experience. Experience taking at least one connected embedded/IoT product through development, integration, validation and production/field deployment is strongly preferred. Must-Have 1. 8–10 years embedded firmware experience 2. Strong Embedded C/C++ 3. RTOS and MCU development 4. Wi-Fi connectivity 5. MQTT/TCP-IP/TLS 6. Hardware/firmware debugging 7. OTA/FOTA experience 8. Experience building real connected/IoT products , not only proof-of-concepts 9. Good understanding of embedded product reliability and diagnostics Nice to Have Understanding of AC load control, relays, triacs/MOSFETs, dimming and zero-cross detection Experience with energy metering ICs (voltage, current, power, power factor, frequency) Azure Device Provisioning Service (DPS) BLE, Matter, Thread, Zigbee. BACnet/IP or BACnet MS/TP Familiarity with product certification (Wi-Fi Alliance, Matter) Awareness of IoT security standards such as ETSI EN 303 645 or IEC 62443

description: Overview Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world. Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture. Within Microsoft Fabric, the Platform team builds and operates the unified foundation that brings together all Fabric workloads into a single, cohesive experience. The platform provides shared infrastructure, governance, security, and a unified data model that enables customers to manage their entire data estate in one place. This team is central to delivering Fabric as a complete, end-to-end intelligence platform. Within the Microsoft Fabric Platform team, we are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build Fabric's next-generation software development lifecycle (SDLC) platform: the infrastructure that takes every change from a developer's local environment through validation and deployment to production. Agentic software development is changing the scale of software engineering: GitHub reports that developers and agents made more than five times as many commits in September 2026 as they did a year earlier, and we are planning for a 50 to 100 times increase in the number of features our teams ship. Today's SDLC infrastructure was never designed for that scale, so we are rebuilding it to match that vision. We build our SDLC platform as a product: agent-driven, cloud-native backend services on Azure that provide elastic development and validation environments, high-throughput processing of every code change, and safe, progressive deployment to production across Fabric's global, multi-region footprint, with AI agents increasingly taking on work across the lifecycle, from feature development to live-site recovery to compliance and security. Every team building features for Microsoft Fabric runs on this platform, so each improvement compounds across a very large engineering organization. We approach the SDLC as a large-scale distributed systems problem, which makes this a backend product development role: we are looking for engineers who love building distributed systems and cloud infrastructure at scale, and who want to apply that to reinventing how software is built and shipped in the agentic era. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead the design of major components of the platform, from architecture through production. We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served. Responsibilities Lead the design and development of cloud-native backend services for Fabric's next-generation software development lifecycle (SDLC) platform, spanning local development, validation, and deployment to production. Architect elastic, on-demand compute and environments on Azure that let engineers and AI agents develop and validate changes in isolated, production-like environments at very high concurrency. Build distributed, high-throughput services that scale gracefully with an order-of-magnitude growth in change volume driven by agentic development. Design deployment services that roll out changes safely and progressively across Fabric's global, multi-region footprint, with automated health analysis and rollback. Build AI agents into the platform itself, for example agents that recover live-site issues and keep changes compliant and secure, so the SDLC runs with minimal human toil and offers similar levels of SLA and reliability guarantees that customers of Fabric get, offered to the developers building on this platform. Partner with engineering teams across Fabric to understand their needs, identify dependencies, modernize existing infrastructure for scale, resilience, and cost efficiency, and drive adoption of the platform. Write extensible, well-tested, secure, and performant code, primarily in C#/.NET, and review designs and code to raise the engineering quality of the team. Preferred hands-on experience building on cloud platform services (Azure or another major cloud), such as compute and containers, storage, messaging, and databases like Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, or Redis. Preferred experience designing multi-tenant, high-throughput distributed systems, including scalability, performance, and resilience. Preferred experience leading the architecture of a major component and taking it from design through production. Preferred experience building AI agents or LLM-powered systems. Interest in reinventing the software development lifecycle (SDLC) for AI and agentic software development. Equal Opportunity Employer (EOP) Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. title: Software Development Engineer, ASA
description: DESCRIPTION Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon’s Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enrich ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination: where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops automation that leverages Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of these high complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and, comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time. We are building solutions to move towards retail automation and are using latest technology like LLM to solve business problems. We believe in “Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History” value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you can juggle three tasks and coordinate with multiple people in the heat of an incident, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too. At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. We are seeking a Software Development Engineer who can design and develop systems for its businesses. As an SDE, you would have immense opportunity to explore avenues of how to model things, figure out right abstraction level, take judgement calls around multiple design trade offs at hand that influence a multi billion dollar business. We are looking for highly talented software development engineers who are passionate not only about architecting and developing large scale distributed technology solutions but also innovating new ideas and providing directions to our business. You will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth of our businesses. In this process you will drive best practices, mentor other engineers, drive continuous improvements in engineering and operational excellence. You will use technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. As a SDE with RBS team, you will work with talented peers of SDEs and Applied scientists to build robust engineering platforms to solve high impact issues. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges. If you enjoy designing and building highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come to join us! Work/Life Balance RBS Tech team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives. Mentorship & Career Growth Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring, detailed and constructive code reviews. We have casual coffee chats with Principal & Senior Engineers from RBS tech. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications. Key job responsibilities We are looking for an experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You work on software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new members on how team’s software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture. Within Microsoft Fabric, the Platform team builds and operates the unified foundation that brings together all Fabric workloads into a single, cohesive experience. The platform provides shared infrastructure, governance, security, and a unified data model that enables customers to manage their entire data estate in one place. This team is central to delivering Fabric as a complete, end-to-end intelligence platform. Within the Microsoft Fabric Platform team, we are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build Fabric's next-generation software development lifecycle (SDLC) platform: the infrastructure that takes every change from a developer's local environment through validation and deployment to production. Agentic software development is changing the scale of software engineering: GitHub reports that developers and agents made more than five times as many commits in September 2026 as they did a year earlier, and we are planning for a 50 to 100 times increase in the number of features our teams ship. Today's SDLC infrastructure was never designed for that scale, so we are rebuilding it to match that vision. We build our SDLC platform as a product: agent-driven, cloud-native backend services on Azure that provide elastic development and validation environments, high-throughput processing of every code change, and safe, progressive deployment to production across Fabric's global, multi-region footprint, with AI agents increasingly taking on work across the lifecycle, from feature development to live-site recovery to compliance and security. Every team building features for Microsoft Fabric runs on this platform, so each improvement compounds across a very large engineering organization. We approach the SDLC as a large-scale distributed systems problem, which makes this a backend product development role: we are looking for engineers who love building distributed systems and cloud infrastructure at scale, and who want to apply that to reinventing how software is built and shipped in the agentic era. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead the design of major components of the platform, from architecture through production. We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served. Exposure to BLE, Zigbee, Thread and Matter would be a strong advantage. Azure IoT & Cloud Integration Hands-on experience connecting embedded/IoT devices with Azure IoT Hub or equivalent cloud IoT platforms. OTA & Device Lifecycle Design and implement reliable OTA firmware upgrade mechanisms. Implement firmware validation, rollback/recovery strategies and fail-safe upgrade mechanisms. Design firmware for 24x7 connected-device operation , including watchdogs, brown-out recovery, connectivity recovery, memory/resource management and fault handling. Work closely with hardware, mobile-app, cloud, system architecture, cybersecurity, validation and product teams. experience Strong hands-on programming skills in C and C++, including object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, memory management, debugging, and multithreaded or concurrent software concepts Working proficiency in Python for automation, scripting, tooling, or workflow development Solid understanding of Linux-based software development environments and debugging practices Ability description: Your Impact You will be working on sophisticated, industrial, real-time systems involving embedded firmware, Linux-based platforms, industrial communications, and critical monitoring applications. This team of engineers develops innovative monitoring systems used for Grid Monitoring, Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS), and Generation applications in electrical substations and power plants. As a Firmware Engineer, you will contribute to the design, development, and support of embedded firmware for monitoring and diagnostic products used throughout the electrical power industry. Working closely with Systems, Hardware, Test, and Product Management teams, you will develop software across bare-metal, RTOS-based, and embedded Linux environments, helping deliver solutions that meet demanding requirements for performance, reliability, cybersecurity, and maintainability. Develop software using Embedded C/C++ on microcontroller and microprocessor-based platforms. Support development of low-level firmware, bootloaders, device drivers, hardware abstraction layers, and hardware interfaces. Work with Systems, Hardware, Software, and Test Engineers to develop integrated product solutions. Contribute to cybersecurity, compliance, and product quality initiatives. Utilise modern development, automation, and AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity and software quality. Participate in Agile Scrum teams to support efficient product delivery and continuous improvement. Qualifications The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, or a related discipline. 3–5 years of industry experience in embedded firmware development, testing, debugging, and deployment. Experience developing firmware for microcontroller and microprocessor-based systems. Strong proficiency in Embedded C/C++ development within embedded and real-time environments. Understanding of embedded software design principles, real-time operating systems, interrupt-driven systems, memory management, and software debugging techniques. Experience working with peripheral interfaces such as UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, Ethernet, and USB. Experience with embedded debugging, board bring-up, and hardware-software integration. Experience developing or supporting industrial communication protocols such as IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, IEC 60870, or similar. Experience working with embedded Linux and/or RTOS-based systems. Familiarity with version control systems such as Git. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and technical communication skills. Ability to work effectively within a cross-functional engineering team. Preferred Skills Experience developing products for the electrical power, utility, industrial automation, or critical infrastructure sectors. Experience with Digital Fault Recording (DFR), Power Quality (PQ), PMU, GIS monitoring, transformer monitoring, partial discharge monitoring, or related applications. Experience with bare-metal firmware development on ARM Cortex-M or similar embedded architectures. Experience with RTOS environments such as FreeRTOS, ThreadX, Zephyr, or similar. Familiarity with Board Support Packages (BSPs), bootloaders, and device driver development. Experience with Ethernet networking, managed switches, PTP, NTP, and time-synchronised systems. Experience troubleshooting communications using tools such as Wireshark. Familiarity with JTAG, SWD, logic analysers, and embedded debugging tools. Knowledge of software testing, automated test frameworks, and CI/CD practices. Understanding of cybersecurity principles and secure firmware development practices. Experience with Python or other scripting languages for automation and test development. Experience using JIRA, Confluence, and Agile Scrum methodologies. Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools and techniques. Exposure to FPGA-based systems or FPGA integration would be advantageous.
